title: Ordinary mate of compact-support base change on a reduced closed fibre
statement:
Fix the global finite-field and finite coefficient conventions [def-trf-coefficient-conventions], with $A=A_{E,n}$, and use the derived finite-Tor constructible operations and adjunctions [def-trf-admissibility]. Let $P,X,Z$ be separated finite-type $k$-schemes, let $f,t:P\to X$ be $k$-morphisms, and let $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$ be a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion]. Put $P_Z=P\times_{f,X}Z$ [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square], let $D=(P_Z)_{\mathrm{red}}$ be its reduction [def-pc-reduced-scheme], and write $g:D\hookrightarrow P$ and $d_1:D\to Z$ for the induced maps. Suppose a morphism $d_2:D\to Z$ is given with $tg=id_2$. For $T=Rf_!t^*$ and $S=Rd_{1!}d_2^*$ there is a natural isomorphism
$$B_K:i^*TK\xrightarrow{\sim}S i^*K \quad(K\in D^b_{ctf}(X,A)),$$
formed by compact-support base change along $i$, followed by the reduction equivalence [i-topology] from $P_Z$ to $D$ and pullback composition.
For $L\in D^b_{ctf}(Z,A)$ let $\varepsilon_{i,L}:i^*Ri_*L\to L$ be the ordinary counit. Define
$$\gamma_L:t^*Ri_*L\xrightarrow{\eta_g}Rg_*g^*t^*Ri_*L=Rg_*d_2^*i^*Ri_*L\xrightarrow{Rg_*d_2^*\varepsilon_{i,L}}Rg_*d_2^*L,$$
and let $\Xi:Rf_!Rg_*\xrightarrow{\sim}Ri_*Rd_{1!}$ be proper compact-support composition. The ordinary adjoint under $i^*\dashv Ri_*$ of
$$\Xi\circ Rf_!\gamma_L:T Ri_*L\longrightarrow Ri_*SL$$
is exactly
$$S(\varepsilon_{i,L})\circ B_{Ri_*L}:i^*T Ri_*L\longrightarrow SL.$$
In particular, for $b_K:K\to Ri_*i^*K$ the ordinary unit, the naturality equation is
$$S(\varepsilon_{i,i^*K})\circ B_{Ri_*i^*K}\circ i^*T(b_K)=B_K,$$
using $\varepsilon_{i,i^*K}\circ i^*b_K=1$. No Cartesian condition is imposed on the square with legs $t,d_2$.
